messages:
maria: heads up — we’re seeing a sudden spike in 502/503s in hosted API (us-west-2). error rate jumped ~8% since 12:45 UTC. affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. customers reporting timeouts and billing anomalies. @raj oncall pls take

evan: looking at logs now, correlates with canary deploy 2026-03-17T12:44Z (release: canary-2026-267). prefetch flag 'enable_kv_prefetch' was toggled to true in matrix slice. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-2026-267 by joel (pipeline #5421) — started 2026-03-17T12:43:58Z

raj: can we confirm traffic slice? i'll quarantine canary and cut traffic to 0% if confirmed. any repro steps?

joel: repro: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

joel: got 502 gateway: "upstream read timeout". request id: req=oz9-7f3

evan: seeing KV cache miss storm, backend pods trying to fetch large prefixes — latency to model backend spiked and upstream timed out. stack trace snippets:
```
E 12:46:01 model-proxy.go:312 upstream read timeout (context deadline exceeded)
E 12:46:03 prefetcher.go:87 failed to fetch prefix batch size=128 err=timeout
```

maria: customers in support queue: 3 P1s, several P2s. billing team flagged increased token counts for a few accounts due to retries. we need rollback plan + comms.

raj: action plan: 1) pause canary routing (rollback to stable) 2) disable enable_kv_prefetch for canary config 3) scale up proxy timeouts temporarily 4) notify support + customers

sam: pausing canary now — running: /ops/orch set-slice-weight --slice canary-2026-267 --weight 0

deploy-bot: traffic update applied: canary-2026-267 weight set to 0 — effective 5s

evan: disabling flag on config service: PATCH /config/canary-2026-267 {"enable_kv_prefetch":false}

config-bot: config change accepted (txn 8942) — propagation to edge ~20s

joel: re-run repro after pause, still see occasional 502s for same request id prefix but overall rate decreasing

maria: support: reply template: "We're rolling back a recent canary that caused transient 5xx errors. We're working on refunds/credits for impacted calls. ETA for full recovery ~15-30m."

raj: increasing proxy read timeout to 60s as stopgap: /ops/infra update-proxy --read-timeout=60s

evan: graphs — error rate trending down from 8.4% -> 1.2% over last 7 minutes. latency p95 improving.

joel: confirm rollback completed and stable version is canary-2026-266

deploy-bot: rollback finished — active release: canary-2026-266

maria: closing loop with support and billing, filing postmortem ticket. put \"postmortem required\" flag on incident. thanks all :tada:

raj: adding runbook note — avoid enabling prefetch on model types with large prefix distributions without staged load tests. will follow up with regression test.

maria: agreed, assign to eng-ml + eng-runtime. I'll open a PR for a canary gating rule.

support-bot: customer notifications queued (3 P1s sent), billing credits pending approval.

maria: marking incident resolved for now, will update when postmortem is ready.
